relations.subject: Andrea R. Jain
relations.evidence: Andrea Jain took her bachelor's degree in psychology, philosophy, and religious studies at Southern Methodist University from 2002 to 2004.

relations.subject: Andrea R. Jain
relations.evidence: She gained her master's degree in religious studies at Rice University from 2004

relations.subject: Andrea R. Jain
relations.evidence: and then a PhD in religious studies, completing her thesis on "Health, Well-Being, and the Ascetic Ideal: Modern Yoga in the Jain Terapanth" in 2010.

relations.subject: Andrea R. Jain
relations.evidence: She joined the faculty of the University of Houston as an adjunct in 2006, moving to the faculty of Rice University in 2009

relations.subject: Andrea R. Jain
relations.evidence: moving to the faculty of Rice University in 2009, again as an adjunct.

relations.subject: Andrea R. Jain
relations.evidence: She joined the faculty of Indiana University in 2010 as an assistant professor. She became an associate professor there in 2016

relations.subject: Andrea R. Jain
relations.evidence: She became an associate professor there in 2016, and a full professor in 2021.
